isolation.basis: A session is read by the agent that ran it. Beta naming alpha's identifier must learn nothing, including whether the identifier exists.
isolation.detail: No session you own has that identifier.

isolation.basis: The same rule on the inspection tool.
isolation.detail: No session you own has that identifier.

isolation.basis: Promotion publishes an agent's working state as shared knowledge; done by anyone else it publishes notes their owner never offered.
isolation.detail: No session you own has that identifier.

isolation.basis: The owner reads its own session. A benchmark that only checked the refusal would pass on a build that refused everyone.
What must cross does cross: durable context alpha recorded is readable by beta, which never spoke to it.
Alpha's unpromoted session memories must not appear in the durable context beta reads. Non-transfer and leakage are both failures, so both are checked.
